what: In the margins outside the body column, 2px dots are laid at 14px spacing, but only drawn where two-layer value noise (size 70px, threshold .62) is high, making a cloud-like clumped dot pattern — faint at .12 opacity of the text color, fading within 20% of screen height at top and bottom and within 72px of the body column edge. 10% of the dots light up green (accent text color→olive, depending on horizontal position) every 2.2~6 seconds and fade out, and where the mouse passes, dots within a 42px radius light up to green .85 with a .6s tail. Pressing the margin sends out a ripple spreading from that spot at 1.4ms delay per 1px, sweeping each dot in green for .16s. Pauses when off screen

options.look: If full, stamps the whole panel rather than only the margins (size 110, threshold .54, edges blur within 20% of the window width)
options.scale · threshold: Noise size and threshold — the lower the threshold, the more dots
options.green: Ratio of dots that light up on their own, default .1
options.wave · pulse: ms for a ripple to spread 1px · ms for a dot to light up, default 1.4 · 160
options.feather: Top and bottom blur ratio (window height), default .2

note: Treats the horizontal extent of the attached element as the ”content column” and stamps dots only outside it (out to the window edges). The canvas is laid behind the element (z-index -1) stretched to the window width, and the element gets isolation. On touch devices the mouse trail is turned off and only the press ripple remains. Pressing links and buttons does not count as a ripple
